verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a first-party GitHub integration: you install the GitHub app and workflow, then mention /opencode or /oc in a comment. It runs the task in a GitHub Actions runner, works on a new branch and submits a PR. The evidence shows no equivalent trigger from GitLab, Linear or Slack. Missing for 10: GitLab trigger integration, Linear integration, Slack integration, independent hands-on corroboration of the GitHub flow.
